data.title: SM Investments' nine-month net income rises 9% to PHP70 billion
data.description:
PASAY CITY, Philippines, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SM Investments Corporation (SM), the parent company of the SM Group, reported consolidated net income of PHP70.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 9% from PHP64.4 billion a year earlier.

Consolidated revenues increased 5% to PHP506.8 billion from PHP482.3 billion. Banking contributed 48% of consolidated net income, followed by property at 26%, retail at 15% and portfolio investments at 11%.

"Ongoing resilient consumer demand supported retail and malls, while portfolio investments delivered stronger earnings," said Frederic C. DyBuncio, President and Chief Executive Officer of SM Investments.

Consumer resilience

SM Retail posted net income of PHP13.1 billion, up 7% from the previous year, as consolidated revenues grew 5.4% to PHP335.3 billion. Growth was broad-based, supported by resilient consumer spending.

Food retail posted steady sales growth across its supermarket and minimart formats, reflecting continued demand for everyday essentials.

Specialty retail recorded higher sales, supported by demand for power-source alternatives and spending on selected discretionary categories, particularly toys, stationery and pet products.

Revenues from the Group's mall business increased 10% to PHP63.7 billion due to an increase in leasable space, higher occupancy and strong demand for dining and experiential offerings.

BDO Unibank's loan portfolio grew 16%, with double-digit increases across all segments while China Banking Corporation reported a 19% jump in net loans.

Portfolio performance

Meanwhile, portfolio investments accounted for 11% of consolidated net income, led by a turnaround in Atlas Consolidated Mining and Development Corporation as higher copper prices supported earnings.

2GO Group, Inc. recorded revenue growth of 15%, supported by strong performance across its businesses, particularly sea travel and container services.

Philippine Geothermal Production Company, Inc.'s 13% higher revenues were driven by higher steam prices which track the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).

The parent advantage

The SM Group's businesses are largely in sectors that deliver strong predictable cashflows. Over 60% of parent annual cashflows are from non-listed businesses, including SM Retail, in addition to the dividends regularly received from listed subsidiaries.

All established businesses fund their own operations and expansion plans and do not require funding from the parent. With a strong balance sheet and reliable cash generation, SM Investments seeks to increase its returns to shareholders via higher dividends and an active share buyback program.

Total assets stood at PHP1.8 trillion as of September 30, 2026, with net debt-to-equity of 31:69.

"At the parent, we continue to allocate capital carefully and maintain the financial capacity to invest for the long term," Mr. DyBuncio said.

About SM Investments Corporation

SM Investments Corporation (SM) is an owner-operator of market-leading businesses in retail, banking, and property, with investments in high-growth opportunities in the Philippine economy. Through its portfolio, SM generates resilient cash flows and reinvests with discipline to compound value over the long term.

Its retail operations are the largest and most diversified in the country. Its property arm, SM Prime Holdings, Inc., is the largest integrated property developer in the Philippines. Its banking interests include BDO Unibank, Inc., the country's largest bank, and China Banking Corporation, one of the country's largest private domestic banks.

For more information, please visit www.sminvestments.com

SOURCE SM Investments Corporation

data.title: SEC charges eight firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
data.description:
The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) charged eight Colorado-based entities with defrauding US investors of more than $37 million.

The defendants allegedly lured investors by masquerading as investment advisers or representatives of crypto asset trading platforms, which the SEC described as fronts designed to steal investor money, the agency announced in a Thursday press release.

The SEC said individuals overseas likely operated the entities and used social media ads to lure investors into private chat groups. They first offered stock-trading advice before persuading victims to transfer money to fake crypto platforms, where victims believed they were buying genuine crypto assets. The perpetrators created fake SEC certificates and submitted filings with the SEC, FINRA and FinCEN to feign legitimacy.

The SEC previously warned investors that scammers used investment-related group chats to promote fraud schemes, including by impersonating financial professionals, according to a December 2025 alert.

The scheme allegedly operated through four successive adviser-platform pairs from August 2024 to May 2026, with operators switching pairs every few months.

The eight entities charged were Advisor WeChat Capital, Tech Brokerage Asset Alliance Ltd., HB Wealth Advisors, IdeaCrypto Exchange LLC, Convergent Wealth Advisors Inc., RealSimple Crypto Exchange Inc., Associated Wealth Advisors Ltd., and Essential Crypto Exchange.

“The SEC continues to seek out and expose fraudulent investment scams that prey on U.S. investors,” said Laura D’Allaird, chief of the SEC Enforcement Division’s Cyber and Emerging Technologies Unit, encouraging the public to report such schemes through its online portal.

During fiscal year 2026, the SEC filed 348 enforcement actions, down 23.7% from 456 a year earlier. The SEC filed 13 crypto-related actions in calendar year 2025, down from 33 in 2024, according to Cornerstone Research.

data.title: Oil Prices Edge Higher as Traders Assess Middle East Shipping Risks, Supply Outlook
data.description:
By Farhan Rafid

DOHA, Qatar--Oil prices edged higher Friday as traders assessed continued threats to Middle Eastern oil shipments and improving global supply conditions.

Front-month Brent crude futures rose 0.5% to $92.47 a barrel, while front-month West Texas Intermediate crude futures gained 0.6% to $83.69 a barrel.

Both benchmarks have fallen around 15% so far this month as U.S. President Trump held off on renewed large-scale strikes against Iran. A stronger U.S. dollar and broader weakness across commodity markets have also added to pressure on oil prices.

The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday that Israel's spy chief had urged U.S. officials to support renewed strikes against Iran, while Gulf countries pressed for negotiations amid concerns about retaliatory attacks on regional infrastructure. Trump is weighing whether to resume a broader military campaign against Tehran.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia said Thursday that a Houthi attack damaged several floors of a tower in Riyadh's financial district, with no injuries reported, according to the Saudi Press Agency. The Wall Street Journal identified the building as the headquarters of the kingdom's Public Investment Fund.

Pavel Molchanov, an investment strategist at Raymond James, said Thursday that oil markets have become increasingly accustomed to periodic tensions in the Middle East, provided they don't escalate into a broader conflict. He said production among OPEC's Persian Gulf members had recovered to 87% of prewar levels as the industry adapted to disruptions.

Meanwhile, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said Thursday that oil shipments through major Middle Eastern shipping routes increased 19% in the third quarter from the previous three months, as producers used smaller vessels and alternative infrastructure to maintain exports.

The agency said shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and Suez Canal increased, while flows through the Bab el-Mandeb declined. Preliminary shipping data from Vortexa indicated that shipments remained near third-quarter levels in October.

Middle Eastern crude production reached 23.1 million barrels a day in October, the highest since the conflict began, according to the EIA.

The International Energy Agency said Thursday that the response in oil prices to the disruption around the Strait of Hormuz had been less severe than the scale of the supply shock might have suggested, amid ample global supply and well-stocked inventories.

In its World Energy Outlook, the agency said the global oil market was expected to return to a surplus as Middle Eastern production recovered faster than demand. It projects an oversupply of 1.7 million barrels a day in the fourth quarter, widening to about 3.8 million barrels a day next year.

The agency also said prolonged disruptions to shipping through the strait could accelerate investment in alternative export routes, with around 7 million barrels a day of new pipeline capacity under construction or consideration. The projects would require an estimated $40 billion in investment, adding about $2 to the cost of each barrel of Middle Eastern oil exported.

Write to Farhan Rafid at farhan.rafid@wsj.com

data.title: P&G Plans To Cut Up To 30% Product Supply Jobs By 2030; Confirms FY27 Outlook
data.description:
CINCINNATI (dpa-AFX) - Consumer goods giant Procter & Gamble Co. or P&G announced its plans for a ?20 percent to 30 percent reduction in product supply workforce, including contractors, by 2030. The firm targets up to $10 billion in productivity savings from ?fiscal years 2027-2030. The move is part of its productivity restructuring efforts amid the increasing pressure on supply-chain costs.

At its Investor Day on Thursday, the firm also maintained fiscal 2027 forecast for net sales growth of 2 to 4 percent and organic sales growth of 1 to 3 percent.

For the first half of fiscal 2027, the firm projects net sales growth on a reported and organic basis at around 3 percent, compared to around 2 percent organic growth in the second half of fiscal 2026 and 1 percent in the first half.

Over the long term, the firm projects core earnings per share to grow in mid- to high single digits, with improved margin, and organic sales to grow ahead of the market, with share growth.

The company projects $30 billion in opportunities for growth.

As part of the cost savings target, the company aims for up to $1.8 billion in annual productivity savings, reportedly from cost of goods sold. The job cuts are in line with the firm's ongoing effort to lower supply-chain costs.

While announcing the first-quarter results in late October, P&G had stated that it expects a commodity cost headwind of approximately $1.4 billion after tax driven by higher raw materials, energy and transportation costs, among others, which would result in a headwind of $0.79 per share for fiscal 2027, or an eleven percent drag on core earnings per share growth.

In its first quarter, the company recorded slightly lower net profit at $4.731 billion, as the 4 percent increase in net sales to $23.276 billion was partially offset by an increase in operating costs. Earnings per share, however, was higher than last year.

Earlier in June 2025, the firm had announced a portfolio and productivity plan to streamline its portfolio and organization, aiming to improve its cost structure and competitiveness. The company then expected to incur around $2 billion in before-tax restructuring costs over two years and has incurred over half of the costs under this plan in fiscal 2026. The remainder is expected to be incurred in fiscal 2027.

In the overnight activity on the NYSE, the shares were gaining around 0.30 percent at $168.35, after closing Thursday's regular trading 1.43 percent lower.

data.title: Retail sales spike after government urges households to stock up
data.description:
According to the Office for National Statistics, retail sales volumes jumped 0.7%, reversing September’s downwardly revised fall of 0.6%. Analysts had been expecting flat sales. Year-on-year, sales spiked 2.3%, comfortably ahead of expectations for a 1.7% rise.

Over the three months to October, the quantity of goods bought rose 0.4%, driven by higher volumes at food stores. Supermarkets reported increased sales of long-life items such as UHT milk and tinned goods following the Be Ready campaign, which urged households to stock up on basics, including bottled water, in case essential services unexpectedly went down.

Fuel sales also recovered, the ONS noted, despite pump prices rising again.

Erin Brookes, European retail and consumer lead at consultancy Alvarez & Marsal, said: “Retailers will be feeling optimistic as the sector approaches the critical Black Friday and Christmas trading period.

“Despite this positivity, retailers are caught between increasingly price-sensitive consumers and mounting operating costs. With little scope to pass further increases onto shoppers, businesses face a difficult balancing act between offering compelling promotions and protecting already stretched margins. Black Friday will be a critical battleground.”

data.title: Michael Saylor sees up to $7.5 billion in ‘natural demand’ for Strategy’s STRC preferred stock
data.description:
Strategy (MSTR) Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said "natural, organic" demand for the company's STRC preferred stock at its current 12% dividend rate is likely between $5 billion and $7.5 billion.

"I don't know exactly where the number is, but I’m going to go out on a limb and say that somewhere between $5 billion and $7.5 billion, there is natural organic demand to hold the instrument at 12% dividend," Saylor said during a live investor Q&A on Thursday.

His comments come as Strategy has been actively repurchasing STRC shares at prices below its $100 stated level. President and CEO Phong Le said the company has bought back about $3 billion of the preferred stock at prices between $95 and $99, below the issuance price level.

Saylor described the current environment as a credit-market contraction that began around May. He said the company is responding by reducing the amount of STRC outstanding until it reaches an equilibrium level that the market will support at the existing dividend rate.

"We're going to contract the outstanding STRC because 12% is a fat dividend for an investment-grade instrument,” Saylor said. "As we buy it back, we lengthen the duration, we strip the risk, we improve the credit."

CEO Le also said that the recent buybacks have de-risked the company's balance sheet after credit markets tightened over the past four to five months. Le added that Strategy had previously expanded STRC from an initial $2.5 billion issuance to roughly $8 billion under favorable market conditions.

Like an insurance company

Saylor framed the support for STRC as important for the long-term credibility of the product. He compared it to an insurance company paying claims, arguing that failing to back the security in a weaker market would damage confidence among credit investors over multiple years.

"When the company is swapping either BTC or MSTR for STRC, we're supporting the credit, we're supporting the brand of the company, we're improving the product quality," Saylor said.

The Strategy Chairman also reiterated that the company has at least three years' worth of cash right now, so it will still be able to operate even if the current bitcoin (BTC) downturn continues.

The world's largest digital asset treasury firm owned 850,849 BTC as of Nov. 15, according to its latest disclosure, which amounts to more than 4% of bitcoin's maximum supply cap. Last month, holders of Strategy's STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD preferred shares approved a change allowing dividends to accrue daily, rather than on the previous schedule.

Last week, the company sold approximately $244.7 million in MSTR shares to fund bitcoin purchases and STRC repurchases.

data.title: Good Design Meets Good Care - OMRON Healthcare Wins Two German Design Awards 2027
data.description:
KYOTO, Japan, Nov 20, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - OMRON Healthcare Co., Ltd. today announced that its Mesh Nebulizer NE-U300 and Ear Thermometer MC-E533 have each been named a Winner at the German Design Award 2027. Both products were honored in the Medical, Rehabilitation and Health Care category of the Excellent Product Design discipline.

The German Design Award is organized by the German Design Council, which was established in 1953. It is an internationally recognized design competition that celebrates excellence in product design, communications, and architecture. An independent international jury judges entries on criteria such as design quality and functionality.

The Mesh Nebulizer NE-U300 is designed to make home respiratory care easier and more affordable. Its innovative design simplifies every stage of inhalation therapy, from preparing the medication to inhaling it and cleaning the device. A magnetically detachable medication bottle, a wide bottle opening, and a simplified structure make the nebulizer easier to use while helping keep costs down, supporting wider access to respiratory care at home. The device is available in Europe, China, Asia-Pacific, and Brazil.

The Ear Thermometer MC-E533 was also recognized for its child-friendly design and ease of use. It provides quick temperature readings with minimal discomfort. With the sensor positioned at the tip of the probe, parents can easily take accurate measurements. Easy-to-press buttons and an alcohol-cleanable probe also make it convenient to use, eliminating the need for disposable probe covers. In addition, silent mode and a backlit display allow parents to check their child's temperature without disturbing them, even while they sleep. The device is available in Europe, China, Asia-Pacific, and India.

"Good design is about more than appearance," said, Ms. Tamaki Ito, General Manager, Brand Experience Strategy Department, OMRON Healthcare Co., Ltd. "It means creating products that are accurate, intuitive, and easy to fit into everyday life. We are honored that these efforts have been recognized by the German Design Award, and we will continue to develop meaningful design solutions that help people around the world monitor and manage their health."

About OMRON Healthcare

Committed to advancing health and empowering people worldwide to live life to the fullest, OMRON Healthcare is a global leader in the field of clinically proven, innovative medical equipment for home health monitoring and treatment. Aiming to realize its vision, "Going for ZERO, Preventive Care for the Health of Society," the company develops products for cardiovascular condition management, respiratory care, and pain therapy. Building on this, it has introduced a new digital health ecosystem that bridges patients and healthcare professionals, helping to reduce cerebro-cardiovascular events, the worsening of respiratory diseases, and limitations caused by chronic pain.

With over 400 million units sold globally*, OMRON has established a leading global presence in home blood pressure monitoring. Throughout its history, OMRON Healthcare has striven to improve lives and contribute to a better society by developing innovations that help people prevent, treat, and manage their medical conditions, providing products and services in over 130 countries. OMRON Healthcare Group is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

* Cumulative sales of home-use digital blood pressure monitors worldwide. (as of September 2025)

data.title: Vinci Gets $439 Million Contract to Build LNG Tank in Canada
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Vinci said it has been awarded a contract valued at around 400 million euros ($438.7 million) to build a new liquefied natural gas tank in Canada.

The French construction and infrastructure group said Friday that the contract, from JGC Fluor BC LNG II Joint Venture, will see it build a 225,000 cubic meter tank for the LNG Canada liquefied natural gas export terminal in Kitimat, British Columbia.

The contract is part of LNG Canada's Phase 2 expansion and comes after Vinci completed the site's first 225,000 cubic meter tank in 2025.

data.title: Circio invites to live webcast on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 am CET
data.description:
• Circio management will provide an R&D and corporate update in a live webcast at 10:00am CET on Friday 27 November 2026
  • The webcast will include a summary of Circio's ESGCT 2026 presentations and advances in heart gene therapy program, including the collaboration with Solid Biosciences
  • New data demonstrating in vivo proof-of-concept for circVec in next-generation AAV capsids will also be presented

Oslo, Norway, 20 November 2026 – Circio Holding ASA (OSE: CRNA), a biotechnology company developing novel circular RNA expression technology for gene and cell therapy, will host a live webcast at 10:00am CET on Friday 27 November 2026.

In the webcast, CEO Dr. Erik D Wiklund will provide an overview of ongoing business development activities, including the recently announced collaboration with Solid Biosciences. CTO Dr. Thomas B Hansen will present the latest circVec pre-clinical gene therapy results, covering the heart program, new in vivo proof-of-concept data for circVec in next-generation AAV capsids and a summary of the oral presentation and two posters delivered at ESGCT 2026.

Presentation materials will be published ahead of the webcast on 27 November 2026.

The webcast will be held in English. Questions can be submitted in advance by email to Erik D Wiklund: erik.wiklund@circio.com or directly in the live webcast.

About Circio

Building circular RNA expression systems for enhanced gene and cell therapies

Circio Holding ASA is a biotechnology company developing novel circular RNA expression technology for gene and cell therapy.

Circio has established a unique circular RNA (circRNA) vector expression technology for next generation RNA, DNA and viral therapeutics. The proprietary circVec platform is based on a modular genetic construct designed for efficient biogenesis of multifunctional circRNA inside target cells. The circVec platform has applications in multiple therapeutic settings, including genetic medicine, cell therapy and chronic disease. It has demonstrated 75-fold increased RNA half-life and up to 60-fold enhanced protein expression vs. conventional mRNA-based viral and non-viral vector systems, with the potential to become a new gold-standard gene expression technology. The circVec R&D activities are being conducted by the wholly owned subsidiary Circio AB in Stockholm, Sweden.
